summary: Defines U-NAPTR, a Dynamic Delegation Discovery Service application that maps a domain name to a URI for a particular application service or protocol. It extends the earlier straightforward NAPTR (S-NAPTR) approach, so clients can use DNS to find where a service for a domain actually lives. It is a standards-track specification.

eli5.summary: If you know a company's name but not where its chat office is, you can look in a special phone book. This lets computers look up the full address of a service just from the company's name.

questions: how to map a domain to a uri using dns
